newsitem.title: UK: ICI firms on price rise news, recovery.
newsitem.headline: ICI firms on price rise news, recovery.

text.p: Shares in chemicals giant Imperial Chemical Industries Plc (ICI) rose 10 pence to 773p by 0904 GMT helped by news that one of its rivals, DuPont of the U.S., was raising prices, analysts said on Wednesday.

DuPont, which holds 25 percent of the world titanium dioxide market, plans to raise U.S. prices by 4.5 percent and European prices by five to eight percent in January an effort to lift the industry out of the doldrums, the Financial Times reported.
"This has been a difficult area for them (ICI) in 1996 and that is good news," noted one analyst. Other analysts noted the stock also was due for a bounce.
